covered: ADR-0009 §6 delivery table, ADR-0016 L43, ADR-0004 L35/52
v1 src/adapters/kiro/index.ts, hooks.ts with git archaeology

findings.claim: ADR-0009's delivery table lists Kiro as 'live test first (r1 notes still apply)', treating the Kiro compaction path as an open unknown. But v1's own Kiro adapter already proves, in source, that Kiro has no PreCompact hook at all: parsePreCompactInput throws 'Kiro does not support PreCompact hooks' and capabilities.preCompact is false. A live test is not needed to learn this; the doc should state the known fact and the resulting delivery path, not defer it.
findings.evidence: v1 src/adapters/kiro/index.ts:92 'preCompact: false'; line 128 'throw new Error("Kiro does not support PreCompact hooks")'. ADR-0009 §6 row: '| OpenCode 2, Kiro | live test first (r1 notes still apply) |'.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 98f0025f 2026-03-16 'feat(kiro): add hook support for Kiro CLI (Phase 2)' first wired Kiro hooks and already scoped out PreCompact. ORIGINAL_INTENT: Kiro's hook paradigm (exit-code only, json-stdio) never exposed a compaction event, so the adapter hard-fails rather than silently no-op. REGRESSION_RISK: if v2 assumes a live test might reveal a PreCompact path and defers a decision, the SessionStart(source=compact) design (§4-5, the 'only re-injection point') never gets wired for Kiro and the compaction memory feature silently does not work on Kiro at release. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: route Kiro through the same bucket as Claude Code/Codex/Qwen/ZCode ('computed inside SessionStart(compact), no PreCompact hook, no precomputing') if Kiro's SessionStart carries a compact source flag; otherwise mark Kiro explicitly unsupported for this feature in the table, not 'live test first'.
findings.fix: Move Kiro out of the 'live test first' row. If Kiro's SessionStart event carries a compact-source signal, put it in the SessionStart(compact) row with Claude Code/Codex/Qwen/ZCode. If it does not, add a fifth row: 'Kiro | not supported — no compaction signal of any kind; document as a known gap for Q20+.'

findings.claim: The subagent row for Kiro says 'deny (Kiro supports deny) with the alternative the subagent has; no hint-only path' but gives no evidence citation for 'Kiro supports deny', unlike most other rows in this doc which cite source files or ADRs. v1's own adapter comment is the needed citation and it also states a constraint the ADR omits: Kiro hook exit codes are 0=allow or 2=block only, with no partial/edit response at all (not just no hint-only path — no rewrite/replace path either).
findings.evidence: v1 src/adapters/kiro/index.ts:9-10 comment: 'Hook exit codes: 0=allow, 2=block' and 'Cannot modify tool input (exit codes only)'. ADR-0016:43 has no file citation in that row.
findings.fix: Cite src/adapters/kiro/index.ts:9-10 in the Kiro row, and state explicitly that Kiro has no rewrite/replace response channel at all (not just subagent output), so any v2 feature elsewhere in the spec that assumes a tool-input rewrite on Kiro (e.g. a generic 'adapters can edit args' claim) is false for this agent.

findings.claim: Pass A's KIRO_API_KEY finding (item 10) is still correct as re-verified, but the fix text only proposes a replacement without checking whether `kiro-cli login` actually produces a reusable non-interactive session token; this is asserted, not confirmed against the Kiro CLI docs the adapter itself already cites.
findings.evidence: v1 src/adapters/kiro/index.ts header cites 'https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/custom-agents/configuration-reference#hooks-field' but no login/session-token doc is cited anywhere in the v1 source or v2 docs.
